subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Will a gateway owner require redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login evidence for this exact head, or explicitly accept the focused lifecycle regressions as sufficient proof after the timeout repair?
rationale: The remaining provider-level evidence cannot be produced mechanically from the contributor's environment, and accepting mock-backed gateway coverage as a substitute is an owner-controlled proof standard.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Request a redacted A+B QR-login run showing account A remains online after account B is added on the repaired exact head.

options.title: Approve a focused-proof waiver
options.body: Explicitly accept the gateway lifecycle suite and CI as sufficient for this provider-backed handoff change after reviewing the timeout repair.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted A+B QR-login run showing account A remains online after account B is added on the repaired exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline identifies them as a channel-area contact, and this is a proof-standard decision rather than a mechanical patch choice.
